svg.text: Upload — one clip, the six essentials, and an empty timeline waiting for three moments
Send me one swing, filmed down the line.
From behind you, along the target line. Before you press record:
Behind you, along the target line.
On your bag or a tripod.
Slow-motion setting if you have it.
or choose a file · mp4 or mov · max 15 s · one swing
Off by default. If on, the swing clip is stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it.
Questions to the coach open once the result is ready.

text.tspan: I find three moments in your clip and pin
what I measure to the one it comes from.

svg.text: Analysing — the same timeline fills in: pose draws the body, swing events pin the moments, measurements attach
